# CONGA

> CONGA is a zero-reflection-at-runtime, generics-first Go CLI framework: declare flags, arguments, and subcommands as typed struct fields, implement `Run(context.Context, *conga.Session) error`, and let the engine build the schema.

## Project

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/conga-sh/conga/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Coding standards, declaration ordering, architectural invariants, and verification workflow.
- [docs/TESTING.md](https://github.com/conga-sh/conga/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md): Test architecture and style guide (single responsibility, AAA formatting, assertion library).
- [docs/completion-wire-protocol.md](https://github.com/conga-sh/conga/blob/main/docs/completion-wire-protocol.md): Shell completion wire protocol (`__complete` entry convention and `CONGA_*` sideband variables).

## Reference

- [Overview](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/conga/): The `conga` package surface.
- [Struct tags](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/struct-tags/): Every supported struct tag and its semantics.
- [Built-ins](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/builtins/): `--help`, `--version`, `--why`, `--completion`, and the `__complete` driver.
- [Domain types](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/domain-types/): root `File`, `Dir`, `ByteSize`, `FileContent` plus the `network`, `system`, and `timezone` kits.
- [Decoders](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/decoders/): Opt-in `json`, `yaml`, `toml`, and `hcl` configuration decoders.
- [Dotenv](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/dotenv/): `.env` loading and precedence.
- [Errors](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/errors/): Base error categories and the usage/completion classification interfaces.
- [Predict](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/predict/): The decoupled autocompletion provider SDK.
- [conga-lint](https://docs.conga.sh/reference/conga-lint/): The static schema analyzer.
